ui_returned_queued: Given back. %s gets it the next time they join.
ui_restore_help: Removed %s. Restore puts it back where it was, with all its settings.

ui_rule_pick_player: Pick a player in every player rule.
ui_rule_pick_option: Pick an option in every rule from another script.

ui_test_check_space: In the same place as the device
ui_test_check_on_foot: On foot, not in a vehicle

ui_move_in_use: Someone is using it. Close the session first to move it.
ui_goto_done: You are in front of it.

ui_change_home_keys: Inside a home only the owner or people with keys

ui_map_hint: Click a pin to see the device.

ui_items_no_metadata: The ESX inventory keeps no item metadata

ui_tablet_use_help: Checked every time a player takes a tablet out.

ui_settings_heartbeat: Check the user at least twice within the free time.
ui_set_sound_enabled_help: Off: no device makes a sound, for the user or for anyone nearby.
ui_set_sound_volume_help: How loud the person at the device hears everything.
ui_set_sound_nearby_help: Mouse clicks other players hear, quieter with distance. 0 turns it off.
ui_set_sound_range_help: Further away nobody hears the clicks.
ui_set_admins_open_any_help: Also the laptops and computers players own. Every such open is written in Activity.
ui_settings_aces_help: Add these lines to server.cfg, with your own group names.
ui_settings_command: Open the panel with /%s. Add a device number to open that device.
ui_set_audit_days_help: Older rows are deleted when the server starts.
ui_set_removed_days: Removed devices can be restored for (days)
ui_set_removed_days_help: After that they are deleted for good.
ui_signal_disabled: Signal is off in config/signal.lua: every device has full signal.
ui_signal_towers_hint: The game already has these masts and towers. Pick one here or click a grey dot on the map.
ui_signal_remove_message: %s stops sending signal once you save. A placed mast disappears from the world.
ui_signal_dark: %d devices that need signal have none where they stand.
ui_signal_dark_one: 1 device that needs signal has none where it stands.
ui_signal_empty_text: Without antennas, laptops and tablets have no signal. Place a mast or use a map tower.
ui_signal_bad_radius: Antenna %d: the radius must be from 50 to 6000 m.
ui_signal_bad_strength: Antenna %d: the strength must be a whole number from 10 to 100.
ui_signal_bad_label: Antenna %d: the name is longer than 40 letters.
ui_signal_legend_bars: Full bars from %d %% of the strength, one bar from %d %%; the signal falls towards the edge.
item_picked_up_other: The %s is put away. Its item is with another player already.
item_aim_surface: Look at a table or desk to put it on.
item_aim_far: Too far. Look at a spot closer to you.
item_aim_steep: That surface is not level enough.
item_aim_table: Put it near the front edge of a table between %s and %s m high, so you can stand at it.
reason_item_gone: That item is not in your inventory any more.
reason_item_place_off: This device cannot be placed with the item right now.
reason_item_place_rules: You are not allowed to place this device.
reason_item_limit: You already have as many of these placed as you may. Pick one up first.
reason_item_homes_only: You can place this only inside a home.
reason_item_home_keys: Only the owner or someone with keys can place devices in this home.
reason_serial_dead: This device was deleted by an admin and no longer works.
reason_item_ticket: That took too long. Use the item again.
reason_invalid_description: The app description is not valid.
reason_invalid_app_size: The app size is not valid.
reason_invalid_category: The app category is not one of dealership, work, tools or fun.
reason_invalid_about: The app text for the Store is not valid.
reason_invalid_pictures: The app pictures are not valid.
reason_invalid_cover: The app cover for the Store is not valid.
reason_invalid_accent: The app colour for the Store is not valid.
reason_invalid_can: The What it can do lines of the app are not valid.
reason_item_too_close: Too many of these close together. Try a spot further away.
reason_pickup_not_allowed: You are not allowed to pick this device up.
reason_cannot_carry_self: You cannot carry it. Make room in your inventory first.
reason_item_tablet_off: Tablets are switched off on this server.
reason_tablet_blocked: This tablet is locked and no longer works.
reason_tablet_rules: You are not allowed to use a tablet.
reason_tablet_colour_item: This tablet keeps the colour it came in.
reason_invalid_open_app: openApp is not a valid app id.
reason_item_busy: Finish what you are doing first.
reason_not_carried_item: Only a laptop or computer that is in a pocket as an item can get its item again.
reason_item_exists: A player who is on still has this item, so it is not lost.
reason_reissue_failed: The item could not be given back. The server console has the details. Try again.
reason_device_locked: Unlock the device with its password first.
reason_single_app: This device runs one app only.
reason_invalid_only_app: onlyApp is not a valid app id.
reason_only_app_kind: Only laptops and computers can run one app alone.
reason_only_app_admin: Only the panel can change the one app mode.
reason_only_app_on: This device runs only this app. Turn the one app mode off first.
reason_password_wait: Too many wrong tries. Wait a minute and try again.
reason_invalid_password: The password is too short or too long, or has a character that cannot be typed.
reason_password_owner_only: Only the owner of this device can change its password.
reason_wall_owner_only: Only the owner of this device can change its wallpaper.
reason_device_manage_only: Only the owner of this device and the people who manage it can do that.
reason_password_not_here: Only laptops and computers placed in the world can have a password.
reason_notes_full: This device is full of notes. Delete one first.
reason_unknown_note: That note is gone. It may have been deleted.
reason_invalid_note: That note could not be saved.
reason_photo_link: Paste a picture link that starts with https://.
reason_invalid_photo: That picture could not be added.
reason_photos_full: This device holds as many pictures as it can. Remove one first.
reason_photo_links_off: Adding pictures by link is switched off on this server.
reason_photo_host: Pictures from this site are not allowed on this server.
reason_device_keeps_nothing: A script placed this device for now, so it keeps no files.
ui_reissue_message: %s gets this device as an item again, with its name and serial. Do this only when the item is really gone: the server checks the players who are on, not the ones who are off.
ui_reissue_exists: %s still has this item, so it is not lost.
ui_device_temporary_help: A script placed it for now. It goes away when that script or evolent_devices stops.
ui_attention_help_no_signal: It needs an antenna nearby, and none reaches this spot. Apps that need the network show No signal.
reason_temporary_device: A script placed it for now, so it keeps its own settings.
ui_search_hint: Search a name, owner, serial number or #id
ui_search_none_text: Try a part of the name, the owner, the serial number or the device number.
ui_first_title: No devices in the city yet
ui_first_text: Place a laptop, a computer or a terminal with the free camera, or give players a device item so they place their own.
ui_who_rules: People who match one of these %d:
ui_access_note_server: Admins can always open it. Only admins and the people under More can move it or change it.
ui_access_note_owned: %s and admins can always open it.
ui_manage_also: Can also move it and change it: %s
ui_apps_none_on: No apps yet. The desktop opens with only the Evolent OS basics.
ui_apps_cover_on: People nearby only see an In use cover.
ui_page_none_text: No page. Players see Out of service.
ui_details_sub: The kind, the model and who sees it. Most devices never need this.
ui_off_text: Nobody can use it. The screen shows Out of service.
ui_off_text_message: Nobody can use it. The screen shows: %s
ui_signal_why_text: It stands in %s. The nearest antenna, %s, is %d m away and reaches %d m.
ui_signal_why_text_held: %s has it in %s. The nearest antenna, %s, is %d m away and reaches %d m.
ui_signal_why_none: It is in %s, and there is no antenna at all yet.
ui_who_sub_owned: The owner and admins can always open it.
ui_mode_chosen_help: A person needs to match one line below.
ui_mode_admins_help: Nobody else, until you choose people.
ui_who_more_manage: More: who can move it and change its settings
ui_manage_title: Who can move it and change its settings
ui_manage_owner_and: The owner, admins and chosen people
ui_check_help: See if someone can open it now, and why. It uses the lines above, also before you save.
ui_check_not_now: %s may use it, but not right now.
ui_why_side_duty: Only as a second job. On duty needs it as the main job
ui_why_keys: Has no key to this home
ui_rule_add_job: A job, like LSPD or EMS
ui_rule_gang_skipped: %s has no gangs, so this line lets nobody in.
ui_apps_sub: Players see these on the desktop, in this order.
ui_apps_many_hint: To put one app on many devices at once, open it in Apps.
ui_page_sub: A terminal shows one page from a script, full screen.
ui_screen_sub: What the screen shows while nobody uses it.
ui_screen_more: More: lock, signal, out of service
ui_picture_also: Also use it on the other %d server %s
ui_picture_also_help: %s. Devices players own keep their picture.
ui_oos_switch_help: Switched off: players see the message below and cannot use it.
ui_place_tablet_note: Tablets are carried, not placed. Give one in Player items.
ui_place_name_help: Shown in this panel and on the lock screen.
ui_place_players_help: Pick them by name with Add a line.
ui_place_who_default: This is the starting choice from Settings. You can change it on the device later. Admins can always open it.
ui_place_who_later: You can add more people later on the device itself. Admins can always open it.
ui_place_apps_later_help: Choose the apps on the device once it stands.
ui_apps_page_help: Scripts add their apps themselves. Open an app to choose the devices it shows on and who may open it.
ui_apps_more_info: More: rule types from scripts, trusted scripts
ui_app_missing_text: No script has this app right now.
ui_shows_on_help: Tick the devices that should have %s. A quick pick ticks a whole group at once.
ui_app_no_devices: No device can show it yet.
ui_new_devices_help: Switched on means a new device gets %s right away.
ui_app_open_device: Everyone who can use the device
ui_app_open_chosen_help: For example only managers, on a computer the whole staff uses.
ui_map_devices_hint: Click a pin to see the device.
ui_map_signal_hint: Antennas and how far they reach. Laptops and tablets need one nearby.
ui_map_zones_hint: Admins can still place inside a zone. Players get a note why not.
ui_map_tablets_note: Devices inside homes and in other buckets are not drawn here. Find them in Devices.
ui_signal_kinds_short: The others are wired and always have full signal.
ui_signal_why_wired: It is wired, like every %s set so, and always has full signal.
ui_signal_why_pocket: It is in a pocket right now. The bars show again when someone takes it out.
ui_signal_why_fixed: It has %d bars now with the antennas below. Save to keep them.
ui_signal_why_held: %s need an antenna nearby. %s is in %s now. The nearest antenna, %s, is %d m away and reaches %d m.
ui_signal_why_placed: %s need an antenna nearby. It stands in %s. The nearest antenna, %s, is %d m away and reaches %d m.
ui_signal_why_note: Without signal the device still opens, only apps that need the network show No signal. Save after a fix.
ui_zones_camera_help: Add a zone with the camera: fly to the spot, turn the mouse wheel to size the circle, press Enter or click.
ui_items_enabled_help: They put it on a table and pick it up again later.
ui_items_only_owner_help: The owner can let friends in later, from the device itself.
ui_items_owner_and_help: People who match one line below.
ui_items_anyone_with_help: Anyone who has it in the inventory.
ui_items_drawer_note: Saved with Save at the bottom of the page.
ui_serial_help: Every item gets its own number. Find who has it, or stop a lost or stolen one from working.
ui_serial_none: No device has that serial number.
ui_stop_message: It is switched off at once and nobody can use it. Switch it on again any time.
ui_zones_count_text: %d zones where players cannot place their devices.
ui_zones_count_text_one: 1 zone where players cannot place their devices.
ui_activity_search: A player, or a device number like #12
ui_did_app_options: changed the options of an app
ui_did_only_app: changed the one app mode of
ui_only_help: After the lock screen and the password, this app fills the whole screen. No desktop, no taskbar, no other apps. Closing it leaves the device.
ui_only_none: No app can run alone on this device yet.
ui_only_others: While this is on, the other apps below stay hidden. Their settings are kept.
ui_only_next: Takes effect the next time someone uses the device.
ui_cfg_group_devices_help: Which kinds the server has, how many and who may use one an admin just placed.
ui_cfg_group_use_help: How long a player may stay at a device, the lock screen and how players start one.
ui_cfg_group_sound_help: Clicks for the user and for people nearby, and the notice sound.
ui_cfg_group_screens_help: One setting for every laptop, computer and terminal: brightness, sleep, night and the light on the room.
ui_cfg_group_os_help: The built in apps on laptops and computers and how much they keep.
ui_cfg_group_tablet_help: A tablet in the hand: where the player looks and the light of its screen.
ui_cfg_group_notifications_help: What a player notices when an app sends a notification: a card in the game, the tablet in the pocket and the screens of own laptops and computers.
ui_cfg_group_nearby_help: What players standing close see of a screen someone uses.
ui_cfg_group_placing_help: Ground markers, surfaces and how far from an admin a device may go.
ui_cfg_group_signal_help: The network wireless devices need. The antennas are on the Map and signal page.
ui_cfg_group_advanced_help: Timings and fine tuning. The values from config.lua suit most servers.
ui_cfg_section_start: Who can use one an admin just placed
ui_cfg_sleep_help: Minutes without use before a screen gets darker and its light goes out. It wakes when someone walks up to it or uses it. 0 keeps it awake.
ui_cfg_use_target_help: Off: players start a device with the key prompt only. Devices that are already out keep their target until the next restart.
ui_cfg_prompt_help: The hint a player sees in front of a device.
ui_cfg_lights_help: A soft light from the screen on the desk and the floor in front of it.
ui_cfg_lights_max_help: Each player sees at most this many screen lights, the nearest first.
ui_cfg_lights_range_help: Screens further away throw no light.
ui_cfg_live_help: Close up, idle screens show their picture sharp with the clock. Further away the screen shows the picture in the model.
ui_cfg_live_max_help: Each live screen is a small web page in the game of the player. Fewer is lighter.
ui_cfg_live_range_laptop_help: How close a player must be to see a laptop screen live.
ui_cfg_live_range_pc_help: How close a player must be to see a computer screen live.
ui_cfg_live_range_terminal_help: How close a player must be to see a terminal screen live.
ui_cfg_far_faces: Still pictures on screens far away
ui_cfg_far_faces_help: Screens further away than the live range show a still picture: black at night, dimmed asleep, and grey on a terminal whose colour is not the stock lime. Off: they always show the bright picture in the model.
ui_cfg_far_faces_max_help: How many models further away can show a still picture at once.
ui_cfg_os_apps_help: Apps that exist on laptops, computers and tablets. Store, Settings, Files and Photos are always installed, Notes waits in the Store.
ui_cfg_os_preinstalled_help: Notes waits in the Store until a player installs it. Tick it to have Notes on every device from the start.
ui_cfg_app_windows_help: How many app windows one device keeps open.
ui_cfg_notes_max_help: Older notes must be deleted before new ones fit.
ui_cfg_notes_title_help: Letters in the title of a note.
ui_cfg_notes_body_help: Letters in the text of a note.
ui_cfg_notes_trash_help: The oldest deleted note goes for good when the trash is full.
ui_cfg_notes_trash_days_help: Older deleted notes go for good when the server starts.
ui_cfg_photo_links_help: On: players may add a picture by its https link from one of the sites below. Every player who sees it loads it from that site.
ui_cfg_photo_hosts_help: Host names, separated by commas. A host also allows its subdomains. Links from other sites are refused.
ui_cfg_photos_max_help: The most pictures one device keeps.
ui_cfg_photo_name_help: Letters in the name of a picture.
ui_cfg_password_min_help: Letters a device password needs at least.
ui_cfg_password_max_help: Letters a device password may have at most.
ui_cfg_password_tries_help: After this many wrong tries the device waits before the next one.
ui_cfg_password_wait_help: How long the device refuses new tries.
ui_cfg_tablet_look_help: The player looks down at the tablet in the hand.
ui_cfg_tablet_look_others: Others look at their tablet too
ui_cfg_tablet_look_others_help: Other players holding a tablet look down at it in your game as well.
ui_cfg_tablet_look_range_help: Further away other players are not turned to their tablet.
ui_cfg_tablet_light_help: A soft light from the screen of a tablet in the hand. A sleeping tablet throws none.
ui_cfg_tablet_light_strength_help: How bright the light of a tablet is.
ui_cfg_tablet_light_max_help: Each player sees at most this many tablet lights, the own one first.
ui_cfg_tablet_light_range_help: Tablets further away throw no light.
ui_cfg_notice_popup_help: A card in a corner of the screen when a notification comes while the player is at no device. It also waits in the notification centre for the next time a device opens.
ui_cfg_notice_position_help: Where the cards show on the game screen.
ui_cfg_notice_seconds_help: Seconds before a card fades away.
ui_cfg_notice_sound_help: The device notification sound plays with each card. Players may still turn it off for themselves.
ui_cfg_notice_tablet_help: A player who carries a tablet and is not holding it gets a short signal and a small card that says to open the tablet, instead of the full card.
ui_cfg_notice_screen_help: The idle screen of the own laptop or computer of a player shows how many new notifications wait. People nearby see the count, never the text.
ui_cfg_notice_blink_help: The screen light of that laptop or computer blinks briefly when a notification comes, so it is seen across the room.
ui_cfg_notice_keep_days_help: Older notifications go for good, read or not.
ui_cfg_notice_keep_help: The oldest go when there are more. A laptop or computer keeps as many of its own.
ui_cfg_mirror_help: Off: players standing close see the idle picture instead of what is on a screen in use.
ui_cfg_mirror_watchers_help: The most players who see one screen in use at the same time.
ui_cfg_mirror_pointer_help: How often people nearby see the mouse pointer move.
ui_cfg_marker_motion_help: Off: the ground markers stand still.
ui_cfg_marker_draw_help: Drawn markers are sharp boxes, zones and rings. Game markers are one stock GTA ring each.
ui_cfg_flat_slope_help: Surfaces this steep count as flat and the device stands straight.
ui_cfg_place_range_help: How far from the admin a device or an antenna may go.
ui_cfg_signal_help: Off: no device needs signal, every device is online everywhere.
ui_cfg_signal_home_loss_help: Walls cost signal. 0 keeps the bars of the street.
ui_cfg_signal_radius_help: The starting value when an admin places an antenna.
ui_cfg_signal_strength_help: The starting value when an admin places an antenna.
ui_cfg_signal_stream_help: Masts further away are not spawned in the game of the player.
ui_cfg_token_minutes: Panel stays open without use for
ui_cfg_token_minutes_help: After this time the panel asks to open it again.
ui_cfg_walk_ms: Walk to the device for at most
ui_cfg_walk_ms_help: The player walks to the spot in front of the device. After this time the device opens anyway.
ui_cfg_walk_damage_help: A player who loses this much health or armour at a device is taken off.
ui_cfg_cancel_reach_help: Metres a player may move away from the use spot before the device closes.
ui_cfg_dark_glass_help: While someone uses a device, its screen in the world is dark under the page on the monitor.
ui_cfg_clear_timecycle: Clear screen filters while in use
ui_cfg_clear_timecycle_help: Removes weather and drug filters from the view while someone uses a device.
ui_cfg_tablet_hold_ms_help: After the last touch the player keeps typing on the tablet this long.
ui_cfg_tablet_use_ms_help: The shortest time the typing pose plays.
ui_cfg_tablet_range_help: Further away other players hold no tablet prop in your game.
ui_app_wants_line: Wants to show on %s. Players see it only after you allow it.
ui_brand_help: One colour for this panel, the OS on laptops and computers, the tablet, idle screens and the ground markers. Apps keep their own colours.
ui_brand_match_help: Copies the colour once. A later change there does not change it here.
ui_brand_logo_help: Shown on the start screen, the start button and in About. PNG, JPG or WebP; it is made smaller for you.
ui_brand_bad_link: Use a link that starts with https://
ui_brand_too_big: The picture is too big, even made smaller.
ui_brand_not_picture: That file is not a picture.
ui_brand_name_help: Replaces Evolent OS on the start screen, in About and on the out of service screen. Empty keeps Evolent OS.
ui_brand_wallpaper_help: The wallpaper laptops, computers and tablets start with. A laptop or computer can get its own in Settings, a tablet in its Settings. Add your own pictures in config.lua (Config.wallpapers).
ui_brand_idle_help: What laptops, computers and terminals show while nobody is using them. Evolent is our picture in your brand colour. An own picture shows exactly as you made it, in its own colours. One device can get another picture on its Screen.
ui_brand_idle_fit: A picture of another shape fills the screen and is cut round the centre.
ui_brand_idle_step_file: Put a picture into web/build/wallpapers of evolent_devices.
ui_brand_idle_step_line: Add a line for it to Config.wallpapers in config/settings.lua.
ui_brand_idle_step_restart: Restart: refresh, then ensure evolent_devices in the server console.
ui_brand_saved: Brand saved. Every device follows it now.
ui_cfg_group_tools_help: Who has this panel and the aces for server.cfg.
ui_cfg_advanced_note: These values suit most servers. Change them only when something does not work as it should.
ui_cfg_saved: Saved. The server uses the new settings now.
ui_cfg_saved_restart: Saved. Some changes work after a restart.
ui_cfg_close_message: %d changes are not saved. Close anyway?
ui_cfg_close_message_one: 1 change is not saved. Close anyway?
ui_cfg_kind_on_help: Off: nobody can place or use one on the whole server.
ui_cfg_error_numbers: Numbers from %s to %s, with commas between them.
ui_cfg_error_hosts: Host names like example.com with commas between them, at most %s.
ui_cfg_link_items_help: Laptops, computers and tablets players buy and place themselves.
ui_cfg_link_brand_help: The colour of the screens, the OS, the tablet and the markers.
ui_cfg_link_apps_help: Which apps show on which devices, and apps that wait for you.
ui_cfg_link_zones_help: Places where nobody may put a device.
ui_cfg_link_signal_help: Where wireless devices have signal, on the Map and signal page.
ui_audit_brand_reset: Back to the values in config.lua
